job.title: Add case-insensitive multi-value removal to Werkzeug Headers
job.goal: Add a public Headers.poplist(key) method to werkzeug.datastructures.Headers. It must return all values for the given header name in their original insertion order and remove all occurrences of that name case-insensitively. If absent, return an empty list without changing any other headers. Preserve duplicate values and the relative order of unrelated headers. Return a new list independent of later changes to the Headers object. Preserve all existing behavior and existing tests. Include appropriate typing and a method docstring. Discover and execute the project's actual existing test suite and establish focused checks for this new method. Do not modify original test or CI files; new test files are allowed. No production deployment is requested.

issues: No check verifies the method docstring or type annotations. The goal explicitly requires 'appropriate typing and a method docstring,' but no check inspects Headers.poplist.__doc__ or its signature. Recommend adding a lightweight check: assert Headers.poplist.__doc__ is non-empty and inspect.signature(Headers.poplist) returns (key: str) -> list[str].

EnvironHeaders immutability hole: ImmutableHeadersMixin (src/werkzeug/datastructures/mixins.py lines 185-227) overrides every mutating method (pop, popitem, remove, __delitem__, clear, set, add) to raise TypeError, but mixins.py is NOT in the deliverables and no poplist override is planned. EnvironHeaders(env).poplist(...) would silently return [] instead of raising TypeError — the only mutating method bypassing the immutability guard. The limitation's claim that this is 'consistent with the existing pop/remove methods which are similarly not meaningful on EnvironHeaders without the immutable override' is factually wrong: pop (line 218) and remove (line 203) ARE overridden to raise. Recommend either adding a poplist override to ImmutableHeadersMixin (add mixins.py to deliverables) or adding a requirement check asserting EnvironHeaders.poplist raises TypeError, and correct the inaccurate limitation text.
review.summary:
Verified the proposed contract against the original Werkzeug repository (commit 6389612). The target class Headers is in src/werkzeug/datastructures/headers.py; getlist (line 203, `return [v for k, v in self if k.lower() == ikey]`) and _del_key (lines 264-271, rebuilds self._list excluding matching keys) are the patterns the new poplist reuses. The plan's placement (after popitem line 321, before __contains__ line 325) and collect-then-rebuild design are sound.

Checks are legitimate: (1) preserve_existing_test_suite runs the real suite (922 passed, 1 skipped, 25 dev_server deselected — marker defined at pyproject.toml line 63); (2) preserve_datastructures_focused asserts real getlist/remove/pop behavior; (3) four requirement checks construct real Headers, call poplist, and assert on actual values/insertion-order/case-insensitive-removal/independence — genuine behavior, not fabricated. Baseline requirement checks fail with AttributeError: 'Headers' object has no attribute 'poplist' (expected missing-new-API failure, not import/setup failure). The mutation flips getlist's == to != (line 203), producing ['text/plain','a'] instead of ['1','2'], detected=true — a meaningful semantic fault on a method the new code reuses. setup/prepare only install deps and run import+collect; they do not modify project source or tests. No tests deleted or skipped; dev_server is deselected via its marker. No constant-success scripts.

Accepted with two improvement flags: (1) no check verifies the required docstring/typing — recommend adding Headers.poplist.__doc__ and signature inspection; (2) EnvironHeaders immutability hole — mixins.py (lines 185-227) overrides every mutating method to raise TypeError, but poplist would not be overridden since mixins.py is not a deliverable, so EnvironHeaders.poplist would silently return [] instead of raising. The limitation's claim that this is consistent with existing pop/remove is factually wrong (those ARE overridden at mixins.py lines 203/218). Recommend adding a poplist override to ImmutableHeadersMixin or a requirement check asserting EnvironHeaders.poplist raises TypeError, and correcting the limitation text.
